pianapur.title: Pianapur
pianapur.description: A website for a local insulation company operating across 3 provinces. PUR foam and cellulose insulation, 5.0 on Google with 111 reviews.

pianapurCaseStudy.title: Pianapur — back online and visible
pianapurCaseStudy.problem: The previous website expired, so the company operated without an online presence and lost potential clients searching for insulation services on the internet.
pianapurCaseStudy.solution: A new Svelte website with a contact form that sends inquiries directly to WhatsApp, plus an embedded Google Map and a pricing section.
pianapurCaseStudy.effect: The company is visible online again — clients can send a quote request in seconds without calling.

tenisliga.title: Tenisliga
tenisliga.tag: Sport platform / QR automation / Real-time ranking
tenisliga.description: An intelligent system for running sports leagues. We replaced SMS threads and Excel sheets with an automated platform where players report results from the court and the ranking updates in real time.

caseStudy.title: Tenisliga — from chaos to self-service
caseStudy.problem: The organiser spent around five hours a week copying results from SMS into spreadsheets and chasing updates in group chats.
caseStudy.solution: Player self-service: scan a QR code at the court, pick the match, submit the score. You approve as host — full control without manual transcription.
caseStudy.effect: Ranking updates in seconds after a match instead of hours of catch-up work. No organiser time spent on score handling — data stays in one consistent system.
